name: Shiitake & Tofu Udon Noodle Bowl in Miso Broth (Night 1)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure · Worlds of Marvel (Quantum Encounter Night 1)
whyItWorks: Thick, soft white wheat udon noodles and tofu in savory miso broth are a top-tier Crohn's comfort meal once mushrooms are removed.
